sentences.en: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!
sentences.zh: 我父母一直在为一些愚蠢的事情争吵。这真是太恼人了！

sentences.en: The sound was annoying but harmless to the human body.
sentences.zh: 那个声音虽然令人讨厌，但对人体无害。

sentences.en: It's annoying to hear people talking loudly in a library.
sentences.zh: 在图书馆里听到人们大声说话真是让人感到烦躁。

phrases.zh: 非常恼人的；极其讨厌的
